record: What a rolled family's hidden stats do, and who answers for the family: docs/FAMILY_CREATION.md steps 3 and 4
verdictMeaning: The best housekeeper at home makes the family's food last longer, and the saving leaves with them when they go. Strength sets the pace of heavy work - planting, harvesting, breaking ground, splitting rails - and of nothing else. A call is answered by whichever parent or child of sixteen or more the family sends, and the upriver march is put to whoever carried the food. Families nobody rolled keep their old numbers exactly. Proved headless, by injected regression, and live in a browser.

numbers.housekeeping: Food eaten at home is multiplied by (1 - saving); saving = (best housework at home - 3) x 0.035, from 0 up to 0.25. Four people resting for a day eat 1.4 food with nobody keeping house; with a housekeeping of 10 at home, about 1.06.
numbers.heavyWork: Work ticks on a heavy chore are multiplied by 1.25 - (strength - 1) x 0.055, clamped 0.75 to 1.25. Somebody with no hidden strength works at x1.
numbers.whoAnswers: canAnswerCalls: any person whose kin role is father or mother; otherwise a stated age of 16 or more; a person with neither answers only if they are the principal.

observed: Rolled a 5: Trinidad (father, 39), Dorotea (mother, 32), Mateo (son, 14), Marcela (4), Soledad (under a year).

The food call read 'A neighbour is at the door. They are carrying food to the people gathering near Gonzales, and ask whether somebody from your family can help take it.' Its answerers were hh-1-parent-1 and hh-1-parent-2 only.

Selecting Mateo, 14, through the family roster: no call on his card. Selecting Dorotea: 'Carry the food to Gonzales' and 'Stay home and prepare - One food set aside, and Dorotea stays where the family can use them.'
Activating 'Carry the food to Gonzales' on Dorotea's card: 'Dorotea will carry food to Gonzales.', 'Dorotea left for Gonzales.'; Trinidad did not move.

At minute 4280 the march read 'They ask whether Dorotea will come as far as the camp with the supplies.', answerers [hh-1-parent-2]; Trinidad's card carried no call, and Dorotea's stated her own risk: 'Dorotea is already tired. Going on will leave Dorotea hurt, and mending takes days.'
